text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock just because it is above my average cost can lock in a gain but may cut short further upside; I should also consider its prospects and portfolio role.","A losing position is not automatically a mistake to hold, and a gain is not automatically a reason to sell. I should judge each position by its future risk and return, not just whether it is above my purchase price.","I should avoid frequent, emotionally driven trades and use a deliberate plan that considers diversification, cash, and the whole portfolio."]}
